figures.caption: Table 1: Performance comparison on GLUE tasks under different Dirichlet splits with homogeneous ranks. The best results are highlighted in bold, and the second-best results are underlined.

Figure 1: Motivation of gauge-aware LoRA aggregation in FL. Gauge-equivalent factors, e.g., (B,A) and (BQ,Q−1A), represent the same update ∆W = BA but can yield different server models under raw factor aggregation. The validation experiment shows that existing factor-aggregation methods are gauge-sensitive, whereas GLoRA achieves near-zero aggregation inconsistency.
